title: HollyShorts Comedy Film Festival
deck: The rebrand: Hollywood Comedy Shorts becomes HollyShorts Comedy.
lede: After three years designing the Hollywood Comedy Shorts Film Festival, Dalton Corr led its rebrand into HollyShorts Comedy: a new name, closer to the parent festival, with the jokes left in.
challenge: The comedy festival ran for years as the Hollywood Comedy Shorts Film Festival, and its look changed every year: an award-show poster, badges and laurels in 2022, a ring of laughing faces in 2023 and a kaleidoscope pattern system in 2024. In 2025 it became HollyShorts Comedy, with a new identity aligned with the parent HollyShorts brand.
work: The groundwork came first. In 2022, as lead designer, Dalton Corr handled the sixth edition's creative direction and graphic design. In 2023 he led the creative team on the seventh, and in 2024 he art-directed the eighth.

The rebrand brought a new logo, color palette and typography, with a design system spanning print, digital and event assets. The laughter stayed; the old name went. The new mark sits beside the parent festival's, and the badges kept the joke, turning each pass into an object, such as a director's chair for filmmakers.
It reached the official website and interactive AR activations, and the award show put the new mark on the cinema screen.
system: HollyShorts Comedy, joined to the parent brand.
deliverables: New logo, color palette, typography and design system
credits: Dalton Corr: rebrand, art direction, design
press: The Contending and HollyShorts.com covered the comedy festival with design credits.
